_comment: RFC 8705 Mutual TLS Client Authentication baseline plan — covers PKI-bound mTLS client auth, self-signed mTLS client auth, and the certificate-bound access-token (`x5t#S256`) confirmation claim. Targets the same coauth instance the basic-OP plan uses, but with an mTLS-enabled client profile. The harness consumes this file via `--config`; field names match the conformance-suite test-plan schema.
description: RFC 8705 Mutual TLS Client Authentication: PKI-bound auth, self-signed auth, certificate-bound access tokens (x5t#S256).

client._comment_certs: The runner injects the leaf cert + key from target/conformance-keys/mtls-client.{crt,key} at run time; the harness expects PEM via the `cert` / `key` fields when client_auth_type=mtls.

cert._comment: Replace with PEM-encoded leaf certificate body.

key._comment: Replace with PEM-encoded private key body.

cert._comment: Second leaf certificate — required by the harness for negative cross-binding tests (Section 3 of RFC 8705).

key._comment: Second private key paired with cert above.

cert._comment: Top-level mTLS endpoint cert — same shape as client.cert; consumed for the certificate-bound access-token confirmation claim path.

key._comment: Top-level mTLS endpoint key — same shape as client.key.
